snippet.title: TreeHouseChicks
snippet.description:
🌋🌴 aloha! i’m kelli — offgrid island girl, exotic seed seller/fruit & volcano photographer based on the big island of hawaiʻi.

i hunt down the rarest, hardest-to-find tropical fruits & sell their seeds to growers all over the u.s. — straight from my treehouse🌱
every seed in my shop is hand-harvested, cleaned, & packed with aloha — so you can grow something magical, no matter where you live!

when i’m not harvesting fruit or planting seeds, find me behind the lens — chasing lava flows, documenting eruptions, and photographing nature’s wildest fruits in their native jungle habitat. 📸
my channel is all about life on the edge of adventure — powered by the sun, the soil, and a whole lotta passion. 🌱🌋☀️

subscribe for
🍓 rare fruit & seed hauls
🌱 growing tips & off-grid gardening
🌋 real-time volcano footage
📦 behind the scenes of my seed biz
🥭 and whatever’s fruiting next in the jungle!

🛒 shop seeds +🌋📸 → etsy.com/shop/treehousechicks
📲 follow me → @treehousechicks on TT, IG, FB & YT shorts

snippet.title: The Justice Journals
snippet.description:
Justice Journals TV explores money, work, health, evidence, public systems and life strategy for people who want more control, more clarity and more independence.

I once lived in rural France with a thunderbox toilet, grew vegetables, built digital businesses, worked inside government, lost my career through illness, rebuilt my life through online business, and now teach others how to become financially independent whilst decoding those policies!

Created by Alison McRobbie, The Justice Journals helps her audience understand the systems that affect their money, work, health, disability, business, evidence and personal decisions — then build practical ways to move beyond systems that no longer fit their life.

Alison’s work reaches millions of viewers across YouTube, Google & TikTok with her books, tools, consultancy and digital platforms ...  for people who want to redesign life on their own terms.

⚖️ Educational content only — not legal advice

snippet.title: AtomiCoyote
snippet.description:
When the world goes dark, we keep the lights on — with junk, grit, and a little chemistry.

Here you’ll find fast, gritty, post‑apocalyptic survival science — no fluff, no filler, just real hacks that could save your life when everything collapses. From brewing antibiotics out of moldy bread to turning trash into fuel, every short is under 60 seconds and packed with DIY knowledge the end of the world hopes you don’t know.

📌 What You’ll Learn Here:

Post‑apocalyptic medicine & DIY antibiotics

Survival chemistry: fuel, batteries, explosives, filters

Urban survival hacks using scrap & salvage

Prepper science for collapse scenarios

Quick, practical experiments anyone can do

snippet.title: Quiet Authority

In a world that mistakes loudness for power, true authority whispers.

Quiet Authority explores the intersection of Stoic philosophy, modern psychology, and high-level social dynamics. We decode the art of composure, helping you navigate social hierarchies, conflict, and professional pressure without raising your voice.

This channel is for the thinkers, the observers, and the quiet leaders. If you are looking to build unshakable confidence, master your emotions, and command respect through presence rather than noise, you have found your home.

What to expect:

Stoic Social Strategy: Ancient wisdom applied to modern interactions.

The Art of Silence: How to use pauses and listening as power moves.

Emotional Autonomy: Detaching from the need for validation.

Subscribe to master the unspoken language of respect.

Quiet Authority Studio.

snippet.title: PreparedAirman
snippet.description:
Prepared Airman is a channel built around practical knowledge, personal experience, and honest opinion. Content focuses primarily on outdoor equipment, military-style gear, and preparedness concepts. all viewed through real-world use, not theory.
My perspective comes from 13+ years of active-duty service with multiple deployments, time as an Eagle Scout with over a decade in Scouting, and years spent hunting, fishing, and working outdoors.
This channel isn’t about polished, influencer-style production. It’s about learning, sharing experience, educating where possible, and enjoying the process. Expect straightforward discussions, honest gear impressions, and practical takeaways. 

The views and opinions expressed on this channel are solely my own and do not represent the Department of Defense or its components. The appearance of, or reference to, any commercial products, services, or external links does not constitute endorsement by the Department of Defense.

snippet.title: SafetyZone
snippet.description:
Where geopolitics meets real-world readiness.
Global threats don’t wait for your attention — and neither do we. Every day, Safety Zone breaks down the world’s most urgent headlines: international crises, rising conflicts, cyberattacks, and strategic moves that could tip the balance for millions. We bring you sharp, fact-checked updates and pragmatic analysis, so you’re never left guessing about what’s real and what’s just noise.

But we don’t stop at news. Here you’ll find calm, step-by-step guidance for protecting yourself and your family if the world goes sideways — from nuclear scenarios and power grid failures to practical prepping on any budget.

• No hype. No panic.
• Just actionable intel and proven strategies — every video, every time.

Whether you want to understand today’s flashpoints or get ahead of tomorrow’s risks, Safety Zone is your edge.
Subscribe now. When crisis strikes, don’t just react — be ready.

snippet.title: Critical Thinker:  Off Grid
snippet.description:
Can we build a life completely off the grid—one project at a time?

Welcome to Critical Thinker: Off Grid! Follow brothers David and Keith as they turn an ambitious dream into reality: helping Keith live independently and self-sufficiently, completely off the grid.

We’re putting off-grid ideas to the test through real projects: solar power, rainwater collection, wood heating, budget-friendly DIY builds, practical shelters, and creative solutions. We share what works, what fails, and what we learn along the way—without pretending it’s easy.

Our ultimate goal? Find the right land, move Keith’s camper, and build his off-grid cabin before he turns 70.

If you’re interested in off-grid living, homesteading, sustainable systems, or simply doing more with less, subscribe and join the adventure.

One project. One solution. One step closer to freedom.

snippet.title: DW News
snippet.description:
Journalism that’s Made for Minds. Follow us for global news and analysis from the heart of Europe. DW News delivers the world's breaking news while going deep beneath the surface of what's going on. Correspondents on the ground and in the studio provide their detailed analysis and insights on issues that affect our viewers. 

Deutsche Welle is Germany’s international broadcaster, producing content in 30 languages. We independently report social, political and economic developments in Germany and Europe, incorporating both German and other perspectives. DW hopes to promote understanding between different cultures and peoples. 

While funded by the German government, the work of DW is regulated by the Deutsche Welle Act (http://p.dw.com/p/17MtP), meaning content is always independent of government influence. 

We ask that you please keep comments and discussions on this channel clean and respectful. For further information please click the 'DW Netiquette' link below.
